name: CalmDown_5
short_caption: The robot raises both hands slightly and pushes downward in a gentle calming gesture.
movement_description: Starting from a neutral rest pose, the robot smoothly lifts both arms to chest height with elbows bent and palms facing downwards. It then performs a gentle, slow downward pressing motion with its hands while slightly tilting its head forward, emphasizing a soothing or grounding action. After a brief pause at the bottom of the gesture, the arms slowly lower back down to return to the neutral posture.
